verdict.rationale: Digits documents an llms.txt for its developer docs and a .md markdown mirror of every docs page, and probes confirm both are live (HTTP 200 for /llms.txt and /docs/overview.md). A product-level llms.txt also exists at digits.com/llms.txt. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle or of real-world agent usage of these docs.
